feedback_disposition.tactical_correctness: Implemented and versioned; actual simulator outcome tests, public counters, restoration, reliability flags, semantic fingerprint, and raw-observation re-encoding.
feedback_disposition.rollout_utilization: Separate critic optimizer; representative actor KL sample; 512 minibatch and reduced actor LR; sample coverage and epoch logging.
feedback_disposition.feature_cost: Prepared matchup reuse, safe raw-roll caching, fused requests, cached per-observation stats, and skipped overwritten approximations. Speed target remains unmet.
feedback_disposition.imitation_selection: Step-zero candidate and per-teacher/balanced validation added. New BC candidate is not promoted on agreement alone.
feedback_disposition.search: Default off. Private-critic sampled leaves and paired uncertainty gate implemented. New distillation requires measured battle improvement; no qualifying certificate exists.
feedback_disposition.expert_coverage: Added varied expert own teams and prospective core exclusions. Collected 128 saved-roster learner-led games with scripted teacher corrections; tested original and 25% correction sampling mass separately.
feedback_disposition.opponent_diversity: Merged near-duplicate training styles, added extremes and pinned historical checkpoints; old styles retained for comparison.
feedback_disposition.long_private_ppo: Two-million-decision run with frozen paired validation every ten updates; current completion recorded separately.
feedback_disposition.saved_roster: Separate saved-roster and excluded-core evaluation schedules are tracked below.
feedback_disposition.readme_encoding: UTF-8 repaired; workflow and search guidance updated.

imitation.promotion: Not established by teacher agreement; use paired battle reports.

throughput_probe.limits: Short cold-cache v5 probes, before the final faint-counter fix; two epochs and no concurrent evaluation. Not current full-run throughput or an isolated caching ablation. The 1000 decisions/s target is unmet.

initial_value_audit.limits: Early v4 probe, not the final v6 model. Weak initial prediction justified deferring search promotion. Correlated position diagnostics do not prove correct ranking of alternative actions.

value_audit_v6_1058624.limits: New on-policy held-out team/seed trajectories; correlated positions are descriptive. This does not validate ranking counterfactual search leaves.

value_audit_v6_1058624_sampled.limits: Held-out team/seed trajectories in the recorded action-selection mode. The critic is trained on sampled actions; deterministic play changes that policy. Correlated positions are descriptive. This does not validate ranking counterfactual search leaves.

value_audit_v6_178392.limits: New on-policy held-out team/seed trajectories; correlated positions are descriptive. This does not validate ranking counterfactual search leaves.

value_audit_v6_178392_train.limits: New on-policy held-out team/seed trajectories; correlated positions are descriptive. This does not validate ranking counterfactual search leaves.
